description:
Hi! Our team is full of people from diverse backgrounds ranging from cybersecurity, economics, finance, data analysis, and technology. We have experience with Python, SQL, and technical research. We’re looking for teammates interested in data analysis, visualization, web development, Earth science, or coding. No NASA or satellite experience required—we’re excited to learn together! 🔥🛰️🌎 

Please provide a point of contact in your application message! LinkedIn is preferred.
